create_dataset_monolingual: create a MonolingualDataset from sentence arrays, positions, dictionary, and language id
create_dataset_parallel: create a ParallelDataset from two sentence arrays, positions, dictionaries, and language ids
build_dataset_iterator: build a shuffled or grouped-by-size batch iterator over monolingual or parallel dataset sentences
test_batch_sentences: test batching a list of sentence tensors into padded (seq_len, batch_size) tensors with lengths
refactor_remove_sentences: refactor dataset filtering to remove empty sentences or sentences exceeding a max length
